name: achromat-mom
description: Achromat Machine Operational Memory: verified community memory of blocked and compliant agent actions, served from Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/deploy-config.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test && npm --prefix ui run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:ui && npm run build && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
